This Land Acquisition Appeal Having Been Finally Heard On
12.03.2025, The Court On The Same Day Delivered The
Following:

LAA No.245/2019  3  2025:KER:21684  JUDGMENT Easwaran S., J.
The appeal arises out of the judgment and decree dated 03.08.2018 in LAR No.35 of 2015 on the file of the Subordinate Court, Thodupuzha.
The State has come up in the present appeal aggrieved by the quantum of compensation granted by the Reference Court.
2. The brief facts necessary for the disposal of the appeal are as follows:

An extent of 0.0338 Hectares of land comprised in Survey No.9/13 of Manakkad Village, Thodupuzha Taluk, was acquired by the State for widening Thodupuzha - The District Collector, Idukki vs Mathai @ Mathew on 12 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83531320/
2 Ramamangalam Road.
Notification under Section 4(1) of the erstwhile Land Acquisition Act, 1894, was issued on 03.03.2010.
The Land Acquisition Officer fixed the land value at Rs.28,507/- per Are.
Dissatisfied with the market value fixed by the Land Acquisition Officer, the claimant sought reference under Section 18 of the erstwhile Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
The Reference Court, on appreciation of evidence, enhanced the land value and fixed it as Rs.1,27,082/- per Are.

3. When the matter is taken up for consideration today, the learned Senior Government Pleader appearing on behalf of the State - Sri.T.K.Shajahan, placed before us the judgment dated 16.12.2019 2025:KER:21684 in LAA No.224 of 2019, wherein this Court had remanded LAR No.88 of 2014, which was disposed of by this common judgment, back to the Reference Court for a fresh disposal.
On a perusal of the judgment in LAA No.224 of 2019, we are of the considered view that the facts presented in the present case are also similar to that of LAA No.224 of 2019.

Accordingly, we allow the appeal by setting aside the judgment and decree dated 03.08.2018 in LAR No.35 of 2015 and remand the matter back to the Subordinate Court, Thodupuzha, to consider the LAR afresh in accordance with the directions contained in LAA No.224 of 2019.
The parties shall appear before the Reference Court on 11.04.2025.

Sd/-
DR. A.K.JAYASANKARAN NAMBIAR JUDGE Sd/-
